      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "\n",
        "data = pd.read_csv(\"/content/houses.csv\")\n",
        "#taking only sqft_living and price for simplicity :)\n",
        "data = data.dropna(subset=['sqft_living', 'price'])\n",
        "x = data[\"sqft_living\"]\n",
        "y = data[\"price\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.scatter(x,y)\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "print(x,y)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "x = np.array(x)\n",
        "y = np.array(y)\n",
        "\n",
        "x = x.reshape((len(x),1))\n",
        "y = y.reshape((len(y),1))\n",
        "\n",
        "x2 = np.hstack((np.ones(shape=(len(x),1)),x))\n",
        "\n",
        "w = np.random.rand(2,1)\n",
        "\n",
        "for i in range(90000):\n",
        "      h = x2@w\n",
        "\n",
        "      E = h - y\n",
        "      w = w - (0.00000000001/len(x))*(x2.T@E)\n",
        "\n",
        "k = np.arange(start=x.min(),stop=x.max(),step=1)\n",
        "prediction = w[0] + w[1]*k\n",
        "plt.scatter(x,y)\n",
        "plt.plot(k ,prediction,color=\"black\")\n",
        "plt.show()"
      ],
